annotations.text:
S4.0.1 first draft — static mockups, not a prototype.

Matches the shipped shell: Geist, the shadcn neutral tokens from app/globals.css, 10 px radius, 56 px header, 32 px controls. UI language English; requirements explained in the bidder's language (German here). Content is the real FR fixture (TED 618320-2026); the company documents and figures are sample data.

Three things the app has no answer for yet, proposed here — tell me what to change:
1. Status colours: met green · not met red (= the theme's destructive) · unclear amber · running blue, all one lightness/chroma.
2. Workspace split: PDF left (520 px), matrix right, one row expanded at a time.
3. Phone: the PDF moves behind a Document tab; the verdict button stays pinned.

The gate (docs/project-plan.md S4.0.1): nothing under components/matrix, components/pdf or components/verdict is coded until you confirm this canvas. Accepted changes are recorded in an ADR, and later UI stories cite the artboard they implement.
